title: KestrelCare Rental Rate Card by Vehicle Program
content:
The daily rate of a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts rental car reimbursement follows the class of the covered vehicle, read from the vehicle program on its Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order.

| Vehicle program on the purchase order | Rental class | Daily rate |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | compact | 40.00 USD (compact-class daily rate) |
| Kestrel Inspected | compact | 40.00 USD (compact-class daily rate) |
| Kestrel Certified | standard | 50.00 USD (standard-class daily rate) |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | standard | 50.00 USD (standard-class daily rate) |
| any other program | — | the plan's rental per day |

**Rule.** A vehicle sold as Kestrel Value Line or Kestrel Inspected is reimbursed at the compact-class daily rate; a vehicle sold as Kestrel Certified or Kestrel Certified Plus is reimbursed at the standard-class daily rate; a vehicle sold under any other program is reimbursed at the plan's rental per day.

*Hypothetical:* a Kestrel Certified vehicle on a plan whose rental per day is 45.00 is reimbursed 50.00 per night; a Kestrel Inspected vehicle on the same plan, 40.00 per night.
